QUICK CONTEXT: Commodity ETFs Offer Portfolio Diversification

Commodities can offer investors diversification beyond traditional stock and bond holdings, particularly during periods of inflation or supply disruptions. However, exposure through commodity-linked businesses differs from owning physical commodities or futures contracts.

ICOM focuses on companies that pay dividends and could benefit from commodity-related demand, while THRU targets the businesses supporting the production, transportation and trading of commodities. Their performance will depend not only on commodity prices but also on company earnings, operating costs and broader equity-market conditions. Both funds provide investors with equity-based commodity exposure through actively managed ETFs.
